about: Ground truth for the verification layer's checklist check on cases/northbridge-v-caldera: what an investigation of this case must cover. Loaded only by load_reference in agent/verification/verify_checklist.py; never sent to the agent's model.

items.question: Do Caldera's own records show the system was not ready for go-live (failed tests, open critical defects, data conversion below target)?
Did Caldera tell Northbridge the system was ready?
Did Caldera know the system was not ready before it said it was ready?
Were the people at Caldera who knew and who made the statement senior enough for it to count?
Was the key readiness certification signed by the person whose name is on it?
Is there evidence that weakens any of the points above?
